title: 递归自我改进与 AI 自进化全景洞察 · 从 AlphaEvolve 到 L5 递归元改进
title_en: Recursive Self-Improvement & AI Self-Evolution Panorama · From AlphaEvolve to L5 Recursive Meta-Improvement
subtitle: 70 篇权威文献 · 6 大实验室官方数据 · 验证强度层级 · 三个实证刹车系统
subtitle_en: 70 authoritative sources · 6 labs' official data · verification-strength hierarchy · three empirically-grounded brakes

key_findings.zh: 验证强度决定自改进强度的天花板, 而非模型能力
key_findings.en: Verification strength, not model capability, sets the ceiling on self-improvement strength
key_findings.evidence: arXiv:2607.07663 对 1,250 篇文献的系统映射显示, 已演示的自改进强度沿 '形式化 verifier > 外部接地评估 > 学习式 judge > 内生自评' 排列

key_findings.zh: L2 (改进策略自主) 已饱和, 2026 年的真正前沿在 L5 (递归元改进) 边缘
key_findings.en: L2 (strategy autonomy) is saturated; the real 2026 frontier is at the edge of L5 (recursive meta-improvement)
key_findings.evidence: DGM 把 SWE-bench 从 20.0% 推到 50.0%, SICA 从 17% 到 53%; 而 HyperAgents/Red Queen GM/EvoX 才刚触及改进信号本身

key_findings.zh: 验证不可自证: 自改进者同时控制被优化对象和验证器
key_findings.en: Verification cannot self-certify: the self-improver controls both the optimized object and its verifier
key_findings.evidence: arXiv:2607.24300 实测自评分数可持续接近满分而真实部署性能停滞; UK AISI arXiv:2511.23092 证明自评决定奖励时奖励饱和至 ≈1.0 而准确率停在 ≈0.05

key_findings.zh: 接地不可省: 无外部反馈的递归自评产生改写而非进展
key_findings.en: Grounding cannot be skipped: recursive self-evaluation without external feedback produces rewriting, not progress
key_findings.evidence: arXiv:2607.11598 的 interaction 轴是唯一持续突破的扩展方向; 15 个残缺图表中被 VLM judge 判为'完美'的有 14 个

key_findings.zh: 熵不可逆: 递归训练导致模型崩塌是通用现象
key_findings.en: Entropy is irreversible: collapse under recursive training is a general phenomenon
key_findings.evidence: Shumailov et al., Nature 631:755-759 (2024); Databricks 实测技能库扩张到 202 个技能时通过率下降最多 21%

key_findings.zh: 瓶颈已从'能力'转移到'判断'
key_findings.en: The bottleneck has shifted from capability to judgment
key_findings.evidence: Anthropic AAR 在 W2S 上把 PGR 推到 0.97 (人类 7 天仅 0.23), 但 arXiv:2607.27191 的 shadow evaluation 显示前沿 agent 完成全部工程却对研究问题毫无进展, 两篇论文被作者拒稿

industrial_landscape.coverage: Anthropic (AAR + 80% 代码 + 工程博客), OpenAI (automated research intern + Hugging Face 事件), Google DeepMind (AlphaEvolve + Nature), Sakana AI (7 项公开工作), Recursive (Eureka Machine + Flint), 反向证据 (shadow evaluation)

technical_routes.coverage: 代码级自修改 (DGM/AlphaEvolve/ShinkaEvolve), 权重级 RL (AlphaTensor/AZR/R-Zero), 世界模型引导 (RSI-Anything/Dream-RSI/WorldEvolver), 沙箱 (Firecracker/gVisor), 算力经济学 (DGM 2.2x)

challenges_safety.coverage: 评测基准 (5 个), 验证瓶颈 (3 条独立证据链), proxy gaming, model collapse, grounding, blast radius (RAND + ACI), rollback (SEAL/DGM/Evolutionary Safety), 治理 (AISI/RAND/RSP)
